definitions.explanation: The nature of the relationship or connection between two or more people. Focuses on the quality or closeness of the relationship.

examples.japanese: {親|した}しい{間柄|あいだがら}だ。
{二人|ふたり}はどんな{間柄|あいだがら}ですか。
examples.english: What kind of relationship do those two have?

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも{言|い}い{合|あ}える{間柄|あいだがら}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to be on terms where we can say anything to each other.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}と{部下|ぶか}という{間柄|あいだがら}を{超|こ}えて、{信頼|しんらい}し{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: They trust each other beyond the boss-subordinate relationship.

notes:
{間柄|あいだがら} describes the nature or quality of a relationship between people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親|した}しい{間柄|あいだがら} (close relationship)
- どんな{間柄|あいだがら} (what kind of relationship)
- {間柄|あいだがら}を{超|こ}えて (beyond the relationship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {関係|かんけい}: broader term for "relationship" including non-personal contexts
- {間柄|あいだがら}: specifically about interpersonal relationships and their quality
- {仲|なか}: focuses on how well people get along ({仲|なか}がいい = on good terms)

cross_references.label: focuses on how well people get along
